faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Collie (Smooth)?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 50-75 lb (23-34 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Collie (Smooth)?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights MDR1 drug sensitivity; Collie eye anomaly; Hip dysplasia. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Collie (Smooth) at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Collie (Smooth), sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
